products.name: SentinelOne Purple AI
products.note: Endpoint security AI; autonomous response; XDR platform; kill-switch capabilities

profile_text.body:
SentinelOne is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NYSE: S) founded in 2013 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. The company describes itself as an AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform that unifies endpoint, cloud, identity, and data protection through a Security Data Lake. Its site positions the platform as AI-native and built around what it calls Autonomous Security Intelligence, intended to detect and respond to threats at machine speed across supply chain attacks, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse.

The company's primary AI product is Purple AI, categorized as a Security and Identity AI offering. It operates as part of an extended detection and response platform and includes agentic workflows designed to handle triage, correlation, and routine incident response, with the stated goal of freeing analysts for higher-value work. SentinelOne also describes recognition in the inaugural IDC MarketScape for SIEM, citing its AI-native approach to security data as redefining the modern SIEM category.

SEC filings associate SentinelOne with CIK 0001583708, confirming its status as a for-profit public company. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts at this time.
